notes.subject: עקרת הבית
notes.rationale: 'barren woman of/for the house': KJV 'keep house' vs YLT 'barren one of the house' vs JPS 'dwell in her house'.

notes.subject: Em i
notes.rationale: Hibru i no gat subjek; participel מושיבי i tok long Yahwe long ves bipo.

notes.subject: praisim
notes.rationale: הללו — 'Praisim' long ples bilong 'Halilu-Ya', wanem Tok Pisin i no gat pasin bilong raitim singaut.

notes.subject: Hallelujah
notes.rationale: הללו יה — tok bilong singautim ol man long praisim; dispela em i las lain bilong Halilu psalm.

translation: Em i mekim meri i no inap kisim pikinini, i sindaun long haus bilong en, olsem mama bilong ol pikinini i amamas. Praisim Ya!

tokens.gloss: meri i no inap kisim pikinini
